recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast 1960s-style album cover featuring a vocal quartet in formal attire against a vibrant, saturated red studio backdrop. The composition is anchored by large, bold, yellow and white typography that spans the upper third of the frame, with a list of tracks integrated into the negative space between the subjects.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black suits against a monochromatic red field
Primary yellow and white text providing a bright focal point against the dark subjects
Symmetrical grouping of figures framing a central vertical axis of text
Circular graphic badge in the upper right corner breaking the rectangular grid
coreInvariants: Saturated red background with subtle vignetting
Subjects in black tuxedos with bow ties
Yellow-on-red color palette for secondary graphics

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four male figures positioned at waist-up level, arranged in two pairs flanking the center, scaled to occupy the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large yellow artist name in the upper-middle section acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left 'stereo' marker, moves down to the main title, follows the tracklist down the center, and ends at the bottom-right logo badge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The red background serves as active negative space, particularly in the center column where text is justified.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red background creates a 'pop' effect for the desaturated, high-contrast black-and-white photography of the subjects.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, extra-bold sans-serif with tight kerning
letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing (touching in some areas)
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized as a compact, bold graphic
The letter 'O' is nearly circular with a very small counter

composition.relationshipToImage: Floats in negative space between figures

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display sans-serif paired with a lighter, condensed version of the same family for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Hexagonal logo badge in bottom corner
Forward slash separators for horizontal lists

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, blocky, high-impact feel of the main title.
Provides the mid-century American grotesque aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of four men in black tuxedos with bow ties, smiling, waist-up, against a solid, vibrant red background. The lighting should be high-contrast with deep shadows. Leave the top third and the center vertical space empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in extra-bold yellow sans-serif at the top. Place a list of song titles in white condensed sans-serif in the center gap between the men. Add a circular red badge with white text in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, saturated red?
Are the subjects wearing formal black suits?
Is the main title text yellow and extra-bold?
Is the tracklist centered in the negative space?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the group
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and song titles
Specific facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Clean separation between subjects and background

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the faces of the subjects.
Verify the red background is consistent and not mottled.
Check that the yellow text is bright and clearly legible against the red.
Confirm the 'stereo' text is in the top-left corner.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Saturated Monochromatic Background] + [High-Contrast Formal Portraiture] + [Extra-Bold Sans-Serif Typography] + [Secondary Informational Badges] to create a vintage anthology aesthetic.
